commands.start_desc: Welcome to the Bandori Bot! Use /query <card_id> to get card information.
commands.help_desc:
Available commands:
/start - Start the bot and get a welcome message.
/help - Show this help message.
/query <card_id> - Query information about a specific card by its ID.
commands.dlanguages_desc:
Set the display language.
This setting only affects the text displayed by the bot, not the information queried from the cards.
commands.qlanguages_desc:
Set the query language.
This setting only affects the information queried from the cards, not the text displayed by the bot.

cards.no_card_id: Please provide a card ID to query.
cards.card_not_found: Card not found. Please check if the card ID is correct.
cards.error_occurred: An error occurred while querying card information. Please try again later.
